title: Maze
overview: Red and Yellow are lost in a mysterious maze, where they're chased by a unicycle-riding monkey toy and a hungry fish.

title: Fire
overview: Chuck tries to cook some delicious seafood, but Yellow keeps interfering because Red is trapped inside Chuck's fish!

title: Beach Volleyball
overview: After losing a game of beach volleyball to the mudskippers, Red, Yellow and friends recruit a mentor to train them.

title: Larva Rangers 1
overview: A city rat and his cronies -- including a hungry frog -- invade the island, forcing Red and Yellow to defend their home.

title: Larva Rangers 2
overview: A battle royale rages with the big-city invaders on one side and Red, Yellow and their island allies on the other.

title: A Lucky Day
overview: Fed up with Red and Yellow's antics, Chuck tries to set a trap and get rid of them forever.

title: Crabsformer 2
overview: Crabsformer falls in love with a lady crab, but she and the island's other crabs are frightened by his powers.

title: Booby’s Love
overview: Booby is lovestruck over an inflatable, rubber ducky-shaped inner tube, then mistakenly thinks it's laid an egg.

title: Mango’s Parents
overview: When the island's volcano starts to erupt, Mango tries to remember the magical drum spell that her parents once used to stop it.

title: Iceberg
overview: Just as the islanders are suffering from extreme summer heat, a rogue iceberg arrives to cool things off.

title: Storm
overview: When a typhoon hits the island, Chuck and the other islanders get sucked up inside of it and must poke its "eye" to stop it.

title: Escape
overview: The volcano erupts again, and a heroic Chuck springs into action. Can he get the islanders to safety?

title: Drift
overview: Adrift on a raft, Chuck, Red, Yellow, Clara and Crabsformer pull together as a team -- until their raft breaks up.
